seo.title: Pallet Loading Calculator — Cartons Per Pallet & Per Layer
seo.desc: Calculate how many cartons fit on a pallet: cartons per layer in both orientations, layers within your height limit, total cartons, cube utilization and pallet cost per carton.

hint.en: Include the pallet itself if your carrier measures the whole unit.
hint.zh: 如果承运方量的是整垛，记得把托盘高度算进去。

outputs.expr: perSheet * floor(maxStack / cartonH) * cartonL * cartonW * cartonH / (palletL * palletW * floor(maxStack / cartonH) * cartonH) * 100

howTitle.en: Why the orientation matters more than the maths
howTitle.zh: 为什么摆法比算法更重要

howP.en: A pallet layer is a 2D packing problem, and with only one carton size the answer is always a grid. The trap is that a 400×300 carton on a 1200×1000 pallet gives 3×3=9 one way and 4×2=8 the other — a single decision that costs you 11% of every shipment. This tool tries both and keeps the better one. It also reports the height you actually use, because 6 layers of 250 mm under a 1600 mm limit wastes 100 mm that nothing will ever recover.
howP.zh: 托盘每层就是个二维排样问题，单一箱型必然是网格排法。真正的坑是：400×300 的箱子放 1200×1000 托盘，横着摆 3×3=9，竖着摆 4×2=8——一个动作差 11% 的运费。工具两种都算，取多的。同时会告诉你实际用掉多高，因为 250mm 的箱子在 1600mm 限高下只能码 6 层，剩下 100mm 谁也拿不回来。

q.en: Should I include the pallet height in the max stack height?
q.zh: 最大垛高要不要算上托盘本身？

a.en: Most carriers measure the whole handling unit including the pallet, so yes if you are checking against a 1.6 m or 1.8 m limit. If your internal limit is cartons-only, leave it out. The difference is usually 144 mm — enough to lose a whole layer.
a.zh: 多数承运方量的是整垛含托盘，所以对 1.6m/1.8m 限高时要算进去。如果你们内部只限箱体，就不算。差通常 144mm，正好够丢掉一整层。

q.en: Why does it not suggest an interlocked (brick) pattern?
q.zh: 为什么不给交错（砖砌）码法？

a.en: Because interlocking trades a couple of cartons per layer for stability. If your load is fragile or the pallet gets double-stacked, a pinwheel or brick pattern is worth the loss — take the per-layer number here and knock off one or two.
a.zh: 因为交错码是用每层少放一两个换稳定性。货脆或者要叠托时，风车码/砖砌值得那点损失——拿这里的单层数，减一到两个就是。

q.en: My cartons overhang the pallet slightly. Is that allowed?
q.zh: 箱子稍微超出托盘边缘可以吗？

a.en: Up to about 20 mm per side is common and often unavoidable, but it is where edge damage starts. This tool assumes zero overhang, so treat its number as the conservative one.
a.zh: 每边超出 20mm 以内很常见，也常常避免不了，但边角破损就是从这儿开始的。这里按零超出算，所以结果是偏保守的。
